summary: Climbing partner reported overdue on Mt. Sneffels after the pair split up on the Lavender Col; one summited while the other returned to the vehicle. Nine OMRT rescuers deployed, but the overdue climber reached his car before the search got underway.
notes: Overdue climber self-resolved before search began.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Mount Sneffels)
